evidence: decorative_mascot: From hook@0.3 to seg4:end the mascot holds one identical arms-out pose perched on the bar tip, drifting row to row (seg0:mid, seg1:mid, seg3:mid, seg4:mid are the same sticker at different heights) — no setup→action→payoff bit.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: hook@0.3 opens on a half-drawn bar-race with three empty stubs and the caption 'Satellites don't' printed straight across the '2000' row label and its bar; at hook@0.8 and hook@1.5 the word 'run the' sits grey-on-grey inside the 2000 bar, and at seg0:mid 'internet. This' again overlaps the '2000' tick — first 2.6s are a slow chart build, not an event. The chart's own kicker 'll2000 PULLS AHEAD' also contradicts the frame, where 2000 has the shortest bar.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The hook has no dedicated opening beat — it is the first 2.6s of the seg0 bar race, with the hook caption burned into the chart's own title/label band and the 'PULLS AHEAD' subtitle keyed to the first category rather than the leading one.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Give the hook its own event in the first 0.5s — the 1.48M km cable snapping across frame / the 2024 bar rocketing past the others — move the hook caption clear of the year-label column into the lower third, and set the kicker to the actual leader so the words and the bars agree.
